subject: methRead()  arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 1 Error

messages.author: 599b212f6d25d24b
messages.subject: methRead()  arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 1 Error
parts:
Hi, 
I am trying to read in a csv file to pass on the required arguments for methRead(), however in doing so I keep getting the following error message:

Error in data.frame(chr = df[, 1], start = df[, 2], end = df[, 3], strand = "*",  : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 1

My code is as follows: 
(It did work for some of the Bismark coverage files and for some it continues to give the error message. Not sure how to resolve it.) 

phenoData <- as.data.frame(read.csv(file = "inputFile.csv", header = T))

sampleNames <- as.character(phenoData$sample.name)
ID <- as.character(phenoData$sample.id)
treatment <- phenoData$treatment

file.list= as.list(sampleNames)
ID = as.list(ID)

myobj = methRead(file.list,
                 sample.id = ID,
                 pipeline = "bismarkCoverage",
                 assembly = "hg38",
                 treatment = treatment) # control 0

The coverage file contents are as follows:

dyn-169-226-108-113:methyl-kit bix$ head subBSR1_bismark_bt2_pe.bismark.cov

chr14 22393492 22393492 100 1 0

chr14 22526104 22526104 0 0 1

chr14 22526131 22526131 100 1 0

chr14 22526164 22526164 0 0 1

chr14 22974984 22974984 100 1 0

chr14 22975061 22975061 100 1 0

chr14 23142028 23142028 100 1 0

chr14 23171743 23171743 100 1 0

chr14 23171787 23171787 0 0 1

chr14 23171838 23171838 0 0 1


The csv file contents are as follows:

sample.name,sample.id,pipeline,assembly,treatment

subBSR1_bismark_bt2_pe.bismark.cov,350,bismarkCoverage,hg38,1

subR1_bismark_bt2_pe.bismark.cov,350,bismarkCoverage,hg38,0
